section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participant demographics for a single study (Study X) conducted in the United Kingdom with 1148 British participants (716 women, 432 men). Participants ranged in age from 18 to 81 years (M = 34.87) with self-reported BMI ranging from 13.63 to 48.05 kg/m² (M = 25.95). The majority identified as British White (88.0%), and 67.7% had college or higher education (38.4% undergraduate, 21.8% postgraduate, 7.5% in full-time education).
